metadata.description: Marketplace for the AWS Cost Audit skill — an executable, evidence-first AWS cost auditor for Claude Code.

plugins.name: aws-cost-audit
plugins.description: Audit a live AWS account end-to-end: attribute every dollar, find idle/orphaned resources, rightsize, check Savings Plans/RI coverage, and produce an evidence-backed savings plan with confidence levels and reversible, gated actions. Verifies prices live; hardcodes none.
